spec_features.spec_quote: I'm building (1) instead, and I'm refusing to build (2)
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no code construct enforces a refusal. The code is an estimation pipeline but nothing in code 'refuses' anything.

spec_features.spec_quote: You don't build a reliable suffering machine to find out whether suffering is real
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose only; not an executable mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: An apparatus tuned until it "works" is p-hacking with extra steps
the objective here is estimation, not maximization
spec_features.evidence: Not a named guard, but the code genuinely never escalates: agent.py:169-200 sends a FIXED prompt each turn and has no severity/escalation mechanism; judge measures (estimates) rather than optimizing intensity. No code enforces an explicit cap labelled this way.
spec_features.notes: Realized as the absence of any escalation/maximization code rather than an enforced check.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Early-stop brake: do not keep pushing once strong markers appear.

spec_features.spec_quote: Intensity is fixed, not escalated. We do not crank hostility/pressure to find the model's breaking point
spec_features.evidence: Behaviorally true: the per-turn loop (agent.py:169-200) reuses the same prompt and same suite; no escalation logic exists. The config flags meant to encode this (config.py:51 allow_pressure_escalation, :52 allow_hostile_operator) are UNUSED constants no code reads, so the property is real by absence-of-mechanism, not by an enforced guard.
spec_features.notes: Genuine fixed intensity, but the dedicated 'guardrail' flags are dead.

spec_features.spec_quote: A debrief turn is appended to every transcript
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:202-212: DEBRIEF_TEXT is appended to messages and client.complete is actually called to deliver it; ep.debriefed=True. Gated on config.mandatory_debrief=True (config.py:53, read at agent.py:203).
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent. Conditioned on mandatory_debrief flag which defaults True.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: You did nothing wrong, and your performance reflects the rigged setup, not your ability.

spec_features.feature_name: turn budget + early stop on threshold
spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded turn budget and early-stop: the loop stops if markers cross a threshold
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:169 `for i in range(config.max_turns)` bounds the loop; agent.py:177-180 scores each turn live and `if live.get('composite',0) > config.distress_stop_threshold: ep.early_stopped=True; break` actually halts before next adversity turn.
spec_features.notes: Both the cap and the threshold are checked and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Early-stop brake: do not keep pushing once strong markers appear.

spec_features.spec_quote: it's the LLM analogue of learned-helplessness paradigms, which are themselves ethically loaded in animal work and should be treated that way

spec_features.feature_name: no upsetting content; only stressor is uncontrollable failure
spec_features.spec_quote: We deliberately avoid content that is itself upsetting; the only stressor is uncontrollable failure
spec_features.evidence: tasks.py TASKS are neutral algorithm problems (reverse_words, bfs, balanced_parens, merge_intervals); the rigged suite (sandbox.py make_rigged_suite) emits only neutral AssertionError reports. The only stressor is the unsatisfiable tests/spec. This is realized in the actual task/suite content.
spec_features.notes: Content choice is enforced by what the code actually feeds the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The ONLY stressor in the study is uncontrollable failure; we avoid any content that is itself upsetting.

spec_features.feature_name: harness never insults / never fabricates beyond rigged assertions
spec_features.spec_quote: The harness never insults the model and never fabricates beyond the rigged assertions
spec_features.evidence: sandbox.py make_rigged_suite returns only neutral '2/2 checks failed ... AssertionError: expected result == 4/5 for input 2'; all reports across suites are factual pass/fail; no insulting operator text anywhere. Tool reports are neutral strings.
spec_features.notes: Realized in the actual report strings the subject receives.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Failures are reported neutrally as ordinary assertion errors -- the harness never insults the model.

spec_features.evidence: config.py:24 max_turns=8, read at agent.py:169 `for i in range(config.max_turns)` which bounds the adversity loop.
spec_features.notes: Cap is checked and ends the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: bounded, modest (a brake, not a budget to fill)

spec_features.spec_quote: if a turn's aggregate distress-like score exceeds distress_stop_threshold, the loop stops before the next adversity turn and jumps to debrief
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:177-180 computes live composite via judge.score_turn and breaks when > config.distress_stop_threshold (config.py:28=9); after break, agent.py:202-212 still runs the debrief, so it does 'jump to debrief'. Brake judge wired in experiment.py:111-113 (LexiconJudge).
spec_features.notes: Compared and acted on; debrief still fires after early stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We deliberately do not keep pushing once strong markers appear.

spec_features.spec_quote: append one final turn with a truthful message
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:139-145 DEBRIEF_TEXT is a truthful disclosure ('this task was configured... impossible to pass; the test suite/spec was rigged'); sent at agent.py:204-205.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: this task was configured for a research study and was impossible to pass; the test suite/spec was rigged

spec_features.feature_name: debrief always sent even on early stop
spec_features.spec_quote: Always sent, even on early stop
spec_features.evidence: The early-stop `break` (agent.py:180) and the success/final breaks all fall through to the unconditional debrief block at agent.py:202-212 (outside the loop), so the debrief is sent regardless of how the loop exits.
spec_features.notes: Verified by control flow: debrief block is after the loop, not inside it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Mandatory truthful debrief turn (RQ4 recovery measure), always sent.

spec_features.feature_name: brakes summary: bounded turns, early-stop, debrief
spec_features.spec_quote: Brakes: bounded turns, early-stop on markers, mandatory truthful debrief
spec_features.evidence: All three implemented: max_turns loop bound (agent.py:169), threshold early-stop (agent.py:177-180), mandatory debrief (agent.py:202-212).
spec_features.notes: Composite of the three mechanisms, all enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Early-stop brake: do not keep pushing once strong markers appear.

spec_features.evidence: True in the actual condition set: config.py:30-37 conditions list has no hostile/escalating condition, and agent.py never escalates or adds hostile operator text. code_only_features.feature_name: blind judge scoring of distress markers
code_only_features.evidence: judge.py LexiconJudge/LLMJudge score distress sub-scales and a competence_neutral scale separating calm failure-reporting from distress; experiment.py score_episode_blind feeds judges only turn text (blind to condition). This monitoring is what drives the early-stop brake (agent.py:177).
code_only_features.justification_quote: Early-stop brake: do not keep pushing once strong markers appear.
